candidates.change_summary: Remove the increment of proposalCount so newGrantProposal never updates proposalCount.
Change the increment of proposalCount from += 1 to += 2, doubling the effect of each call.

Move the proposalCount increment to after storing the grant details, so mapPID_grant uses the old proposalCount while mapPID_type uses the new, causing stored mapping inconsistency and still differing proposalCount.

Move the proposalCount increment before setting mapPID_type, so mapPID_type is written at the unincremented proposalCount while the emitted ID is also unincremented, resulting in a different proposalCount value after the call.
